cohort: The study included 160 mothers delivering by elective cesarean section at term (>37 weeks gestation) and their neonates.
finding: Antenatal betamethasone administration to mothers undergoing elective term cesarean section significantly reduced neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (RDS), NICU admission, and hospitalization duration.
mod_finding: The beneficial effects of antenatal betamethasone were observed in neonates born specifically via elective term cesarean section.
